title: Plain G1 ECDLP: (4,3) CM-STNFS over Q(zeta_15) with tiled Arch2-Rev-SigmaB behind a run gate: expected work 2^112.905540376747

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns scalar x in 0..r-1 from T=[x]P0 via g=e(P0,Q0), z=e(T,Q0)=g^x with fresh-coin boot randomization with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1, H1', H-EA, H-FFT, H2, H3, H-SM, H4, H4u, H-X and H5 (explicitly including de Bruijn local-density correction in both collection and descent, 4-parameter deterministic hard-capped LA at (N_cap, N_sw_cap, k5_cap, tab_r_cap) with P_CAP=0.020, deterministic 50% boot-ball norm filter at m_max=2600b, and H5 conditional independence across the 48 rerandomized boot relations), at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^110.9092333844+2^66) < 2^112.905540376747 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000; 1 core unit = 10 G1 units): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7359833809289549279, (K/2^64) x 0.977499 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.977499 (strict additive union bound) and costs at most 2^118.976525390188 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
